column1: # HGVS corpus for exercising HGVS parsing, comparison and sorting.
# Provenance - nothing here derives from lab submissions or patient data:
#   refseq_c / ensembl_c / genomic_g  ClinVar HGVS from SACGF/cdot
#   with_gene_symbol                  the same cdot accessions, gene symbol added from
#                                     HGNC/cdot reference data - the form labs submit
#   unversioned_transcript            cdot accessions with the version dropped
#   everything else                   hand written edge cases
# Deliberately includes malformed input: HGVS parsing is lenient by design, since it
# has to cope with whatever is already in the database. Do not assume a line is valid.
# Format: <category>\t<hgvs>   ('' is a real entry - the empty string is a used idiom)
